# Automated Linux Log Monitor & Alerting Pipeline

[![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-Containerized-blue.svg)](https://www.docker.com/)
[![Prometheus](https://img.shields.io/badge/Prometheus-Monitoring-orange.svg)](https://prometheus.io/)
[![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.11%2B-green.svg)](https://python.org)

## 📌 Business Overview
A lightweight, containerized log monitoring and telemetry pipeline designed for Linux environments. It ingests system events, parses error spikes using a custom Python daemon, and exposes Prometheus metrics for real-time operational visibility.

---

## 🏗️ Architecture Stack
- **Container Engine**: Docker & Docker Compose
- **Telemetry & Scraping**: Prometheus (Custom Exporter via Python)
- **Dashboards**: Grafana
- **Log Processing**: Python 3.11 (Regex & In-Memory Pipeline)
- **Automation**: Bash Scripts

```
+------------------+      +-------------------+      +------------------+
|  Linux Syslogs   | ---> | Python Log Daemon | ---> | Prometheus Scrap |
+------------------+      +-------------------+      +------------------+
                                                               |
                                                               v
                                                     +------------------+
                                                     | Grafana Monitor  |
                                                     +------------------+
```

---

## 📁 Project Structure
```bash
.
├── docker-compose.yml
├── prometheus/
│   └── prometheus.yml
├── src/
│   ├── monitor.py
│   └── requirements.txt
├── scripts/
│   └── setup_env.sh
└── README.md
```

---

## 🚀 Quickstart Guide

### 1. Clone the repository
```bash
git clone https://github.com/your-username/linux-log-monitor.git
cd linux-log-monitor
```

### 2. Launch Services
```bash
docker-compose up -d --build
```

### 3. Verify Health
- **Prometheus Dashboard**: `http://localhost:9090`
- **Grafana Metrics**: `http://localhost:3000` (Default: `admin` / `admin`)

---

## 🧪 Verification & Testing
To generate synthetic error spikes and observe automated alerts:
```bash
python scripts/generate_mock_spikes.py --rate 50
```
